snippet.title: Neville Longbottom RUIN Matthew Lewis' Life After Harry Potter?
snippet.description: Did you know Neville Longbottom’s transformation on-screen came with real-life challenges? Actor Matthew Lewis had to wear fake teeth, plastic ear inserts, and even a fat suit to match Neville's clumsy and awkward persona in the books. These adjustments took a toll on his mental health, but Matthew overcame it all and has since become a fan-favorite in the Harry Potter world. From clumsy beginnings to heroic moments, Neville’s journey is unforgettable.
